contract_review.EXPORT-VECTOR: PNG plus PDF were selected to minimize files; SVG not required in this report.
contract_review.EXPORT-RASTER: PNG was selected; no TIFF journal submission requested.
contract_review.RASTER-DPI: 360 dpi exceeds the 300 dpi floor; editable PDF also supplied.
contract_review.FINAL-WIDTH: These are readable analysis report plates, not a journal page-width submission.

visual_inspection.scope: All eight final figures, individual panels, labels, legends, scales, captions and full-figure composition inspected. PDF geometry also checked at export size.
visual_inspection.intentional_overlays: Figure08 cell values overlay colored cells; feature net bars overlay mass bars; legends use filled swatches; no unintended text overlap or clipping.
